# Rate-GPT

Rate-GPT helps farmers explore government-reported mandi prices in India and compare observations by crop and market.

## Machine-readable API
- OpenAPI specification: https://rate-gpt.vercel.app/openapi.json
- API discovery: https://rate-gpt.vercel.app/api/v1/
- API reference: https://rate-gpt.vercel.app/docs/api.md
- Mandi prices page: https://rate-gpt.vercel.app/mandi-prices.html

## API usage
- Base URL: https://rate-gpt.vercel.app/api/v1
- GET /meta/filters?state=Himachal%20Pradesh
- GET /prices?state=Himachal%20Pradesh&limit=50&offset=0
- GET /prices/compare?commodity=Apple&date=2026-11-13
- GET /commodities/search?q=Potato
- GET /sync-status

## Data and interpretation
- Data source: Government of India OGD / AGMARKNET.
- Price records are fetched on demand; Rate-GPT does not persist price observations.
- Published arrival-date observations are not guaranteed real-time trading quotes.
- Always read each record's source_unit. If the source does not provide a unit, it is explicitly marked as not provided.
- Missing prices are null, not zero.
- Use pagination metadata and inspect coverage/truncation fields before claiming completeness.
- Compare only like-for-like commodity, variety, grade and source unit. Account for transport, quality and other costs separately.
- Do not infer prices or mandi availability from the administrative directory alone.
- Historical trend endpoint returns HTTP 410 because historical price storage is disabled.

## Response format
Successful API responses use { success: true, data, meta?, message }. Errors use { success: false, error: { code, message } }.
